scenarios.scenario-1: --files maps changed files to direct modules (exact PATH, directory prefix, docs entity), their transitive dependents, the verification/test blast radius and affected phases; suggested commands include scoped verify and ci.
scenarios.scenario-2: --files works with no git metadata; --staged/--since use git argv-only and degrade to a usage error (exit 2) when no changed-file source exists.
scenarios.scenario-3: Files that map to no module produce a NO_MODULES_AFFECTED info finding and still exit 0; JSON mode exposes files, modules, dependents, phases and commands.

required-log-markers.marker-1: CLI text/JSON output is asserted by the tests; git and library paths emit no runtime log markers.

notes.note-1: Covered by test/grace-impact.test.ts (explicit files, staged/since scopes, mapping reasons, dependent closure, trust note, exit codes, JSON envelope).
notes.note-2: Scope precedence: --files → --staged → --since <ref> → git diff HEAD; no source is a usage error (exit 2).
notes.note-3: CLI surface: mygrace impact [--files a,b,c] [--since <ref>] [--staged] [--path .] [--format text|json].
